title: Measuring the Verifier's Floor: How Much Apparent Rare-Word Text-to-Speech Error Is ASR Error?
abstract: arXiv:2610.31470v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-speech (TTS) is usually evaluated by transcribing its output with an automatic speech recognition (ASR) system, so the word error rate also counts recognizer errors. We measure these errors on human recordings of the test sentences. On LibriSpeech and FLEURS, the evaluation recognizer misses 33-67% of very rare words even in human speech, and all three recognizers miss 22-42%. Checking every word with two more recognizer families lowers the apparent TTS error on words that at least one recognizer hears two- to three-fold (very rare LibriSpeech words: from 10-13% to 3-5%), yet very rare words remain the hardest. Ignoring words the recognizer misses in human speech is biased: the other recognizers find TTS errors far more often on these words (4-6% vs. 0.2-0.3%) and overturn about half of the errors this mask keeps. As half of the remaining adjudicated errors may be spelling variants, a listening test is needed.

translated_title: 测量验证器的下限：表面上的罕见词文本转语音错误中有多少其实是ASR错误？
translated_abstract: 文本转语音（TTS）通常通过使用自动语音识别（ASR）系统对其输出进行转录来评估，因此词错误率中也计入了识别器自身的错误。我们在测试句子的人类录音上测量了这些错误。在LibriSpeech和FLEURS数据集上，评估用的识别器即使在人类语音中也会漏掉33-67%的极罕见词，而三个识别器全部漏掉的比例为22-42%。用另外两个识别器家族对每个词进行核查后，对于至少有一个识别器能听到的词，表面上的TTS错误率降低了两到三倍（LibriSpeech中极罕见词的错误率从10-13%降至3-5%），但极罕见词仍然是最难的部分。忽略识别器在人类语音中漏掉的词是有偏见的：其他识别器在这些词上发现TTS错误的频率要高得多（4-6%对比0.2-0.3%），并推翻了这种掩蔽方法所保留的约一半错误。由于剩余经裁定的错误中可能有一半是拼写变体，因此仍需进行听音测试。
tldr: 该研究量化了ASR评估系统本身的错误下限——即使在人类语音上也会漏掉33-67%的极罕见词——表明TTS评估中相当一部分“错误”实为识别器局限，多识别器交叉验证可将表面错误率降低两到三倍，但最终仍需人工听音测试裁定。
en_tdlr: This study quantifies the ASR verifier's floor—missing 33-67% of very rare words even in human speech—showing that much apparent TTS error is actually recognizer error; cross-checking with multiple recognizer families reduces apparent error two- to three-fold, but a human listening test remains necessary for final adjudication.
